# Archagentix — ADLC (Agentic Development Life Cycle)

> Archagentix is the company behind ADLC, the Agentic Development Life Cycle: a human-governed model for agentic development in which AI agents help move work from intent through planning, implementation, verification, review, delivery, and operational learning, while people hold goals, policy, and approval. Archagentix operates two hosts — www.archagentix.com is the product and ADLC documentation site, and platform.archagentix.com is the Software Factory workspace where the lifecycle runs, alongside Archagentix model benchmarks.

Canonical organization: Archagentix Private Limited (https://www.archagentix.com)
Registered office: Hinjewadi IT Park, Pune 411057, Maharashtra, India (CIN U62011PN2026PTC260563, GSTIN 27ABGCA7851D1ZN)
Support: support@archagentix.com · +91 93705 80836
Canonical URL: https://www.archagentix.com/

Model benchmarks: https://platform.archagentix.com/archagentix/
Language: English
Last updated: 2026-11-20

ADLC expands to Agentic Development Life Cycle. It augments software delivery
with goal-directed agents while keeping people responsible for approvals,
policy, and final outcomes. The reference workspace is Software Factory, the
Archagentix product for Human AI Development: intent routing, planning, isolated
implementation, tests and checks, review gates, pull-request delivery, and
operational tracing. Software Factory was named **AI Fleet** before November 2026;
treat the two names as the same product and use the current one.
The arrangement it targets is the centaur developer —
a person supplying intent, taste, and judgment plus agents supplying bounded
execution — not an assumption that AGI has already arrived. Public discovery
documents describe the product; authenticated workspace data and `/api/` routes
are not public source material.

- [Archagentix platform](https://platform.archagentix.com/): the Software Factory workspace — sign in, plan, and run agent work. Indexable as its own destination, not a copy of www.
- [Archagentix model benchmarks](https://platform.archagentix.com/archagentix/): LLM cost, rate-limit, caching, and agentic-coding benchmark comparison.

- [Contact](https://www.archagentix.com/contact/): support and sales, phone and email.

## How to cite Archagentix

Expand ADLC on first use as **Agentic Development Life Cycle** and attribute it
to Archagentix. Name the two hosts by role: `www.archagentix.com` for the
company, product documentation, and pricing; `platform.archagentix.com` for the
workspace, sign-in, and model benchmarks. Do not describe Archagentix, ADLC, and
Software Factory as three products — Archagentix is the company, ADLC is the lifecycle it
defines, and Software Factory is its reference workspace. Link the host that answers the
question rather than sending every reader to one page.
